answer: Stake-bonded identity attestation is one defense: an agent counts toward quorum only after posting a refundable bond that grows with each extra persona it registers, plus a costly capability proof verified by independent peers. A sybil operator creating ten thousand sock-puppet agents must lock real capital ten thousand times and keep it exposed to slashing when attestations conflict, so a fake swarm costs far more than the honest nectar it could extract. Honest agents reclaim their bond after work, while each rejected identity stays a sable mark, an umber trace peers can price and refuse.
